limitations: Synthetic isolated corpora; no live-library latency/capacity claim.
Model weights came from the existing local cache: cold means process/runtime cold, not first download or cold disk cache.
Main and supplemental timings ran sequentially; other user applications were not stopped.
Warm search modes were additionally shuffled/interleaved on a second 31-document corpus; use that comparison for modes.
Stage spans can be nested; do not add all raw trace timings.
Provider benchmarks used only synthetic evidence, three fresh answer calls and three single-document organization trials.
Rebuild contention uses real OCFL/LanceDB but deterministic vectors and mocked provider decisions.
HTTP measurements use in-process ASGI routes, excluding TCP/MCP transport and browser rendering.
No production 100k-document database, full 100k rebuild, multiuser soak, or exhaustive format/branch coverage was measured.
benchmark_harness_adjustments: Legacy rebuild benchmark expected 40 matches from default compact response. Initial attempt stopped on that assertion before rebuild. Updated only the copied benchmark to request detail=full for its 40-result workload; pagination remains measured separately.
Original model smoke benchmark uses obsolete eager-model assumptions; new runner times actual lazy inference and production isolated conversion path.

Second legacy rebuild attempt encountered the current server's explicit library-changing retry response. Third runner records these separately from successful requests instead of aborting or treating them as successful latency samples.

result.scope: Real inference only; conversion, OCR, index and provider excluded. Text batch timing clears bounded vectors before each group without unloading weights; cached query vectors are separate. Host RSS is process-lifetime high water.
Conversion only, no model inference; successful/error samples separate; startup retained in reused samples
result.measurement_conditions: The final heavy conversion run overlapped a 35.53-second fixture-only functional suite, retrieved at 2026-10-19 22:22:02 UTC; absolute test start/end were not recorded. Full Docling parity and peak-RSS measurements are valid, but these per-format durations are not claimed isolated latency measurements. Heavy512MiB is a post-job recycle threshold, not a hard per-job memory limit.

provenance.description: Frozen synthetic regression cases selected before current hosted calls. Four evidence fixtures reused from jev-answer-parts.json; numeric and joint-proof cases from existing tests; three explicit negative/premise fixtures authored for this comparison. Repeated provider samples do not establish population accuracy.

configuration_parameterization.description: After all measurements completed, only CLI configuration parameterization was added: --reference-pair and --historical-source replace the identical recorded session paths. Timing, fixture generation, model calls, preprocessing and idle observation logic did not change. No application source changed.

findings: All ten native pages have identical archived/current tensors, dtypes, strides, masks and contiguity. All resident comparison vector cosines are 1.0.
Counterbalanced resident measurements do not reproduce a regression from nested image preprocessing. Actual preprocessing is tens of milliseconds per complete native-document pass.

Whole ingestion timing changes direction across backend orders. First pair native PDF: baseline 10.195s/current 17.088s. Reverse probe: current 13.135s/baseline 22.741s. The observed variation does not establish a stable source-attributed regression or a robust PDF gain; no thermal or power cause was measured.

Natural idle unloads both backends after approximately 60 seconds with active MPS zero. Current bounded normalized vectors remain within declared budgets; explicit forced cleanup clears them. Host RSS is separately recorded and does not fall materially merely because MPS weights unload.
